mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 225 triggers fears of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0) combined with strong housing demand (HOUST > 500) signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic overheating, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0) indicates a tight labor market that may fuel wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the Fed tightens.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 380000) and high housing starts (HOUST > 520) together signal robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in less than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.1% over the past three months signals monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines > 0.1% in last 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
